description: Reddit Posts & Subreddit Search: search public Reddit posts by keyword, within one subreddit, or list a subreddit's newest posts. Per post the title, text, subreddit, author, upvotes, comment count, linked URL, time and permalink in the shared social schema; next_cursor gives the next page. Forum research and social listening. Bad input is free; not found or no match is not charged. Price: $0.02 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

q.description: Search text (1-200 characters). Give q, subreddit or both.

subreddit.description: Limit to one community: a subreddit name: 2 to 21 letters, digits or underscores, with or without r/. Alone it returns the subreddit's newest posts.
